title: Thresholds file
description: Committed thresholds for one category (kind) and optionally one environment. Written by the thresholds generator (10) or by hand; read by the reporter and the CLI.

generated.description: How the file was derived. Null for a file written entirely by hand. Contains no wall-clock time of generation, so deriving twice from the same report gives identical files (S-04).

entries.description: Thresholds per key. Object keys are aggregate keys and are written sorted (P-09).

sourceRunId.description: runId of the report the thresholds were derived from.

sourceSampleCount.description: Successful samples of this kind in the source report.

evaluatedPercentile.description: Percentile the 'percentile' limits refer to. The reporter warns when the current config evaluates a different one (00, 4.4).

derivation.description: Derivation settings used for this kind (config checks.slowShare.t.<kind>, thresholds.smallSampleN, checks.*.margin; 03, 10).

browsers.description: browserName of the measured projects of the source run (runConditions.projects with role measured), sorted, unique. Compared with the evaluated run (09-REQ-04).

playwrightVersion.description: Playwright version of the source run (FullConfig.version). The reporter compares major.minor (09-REQ-04).

host.description: Machine of the source run (copy of the run report host fingerprint).

normalization.description: Fingerprint of the normalization that produced the keys: built-in rules version, effective keys config and base origins (07-REQ-21). A different value means the keys may not match.

entry.description: Limits for one key. A complete entry has all seven limit fields; the generator always writes complete entries. t, minApdex and maxWilson may be null: the apdex and wilson rules do not apply to this key (10-REQ-06). Hand-written entries may omit fields (02-REQ-21): missing median, percentile, p99 and maxErrorRate come from checks.<group>.<rule>.limit of the current config; without t the apdex and wilson rules are off; with t, a missing minApdex or maxWilson comes from checks.slowShare.apdex.limit / wilson.limit. An entry may contain only muting (gate, note, until) without any limit (02-REQ-29). An entry with a missing field is never overwritten by the generator (10-REQ-08).

t.description: Apdex T and slow-sample threshold for the wilson rule, or null.

minApdex.description: Minimum Apdex(T), compared with the upper bound of its 95% interval (09-REQ-09), or null.

maxWilson.description: Maximum share of samples slower than T, compared with the lower bound of its 95% Wilson interval (09-REQ-09), or null.

maxErrorRate.description: Maximum error rate (checks.errors.statuses), compared with the lower bound of its 95% Wilson interval (09-REQ-09).

locked.description: Pinned by hand: the generator never changes or removes this entry (D-19). Omitted when not locked.

note.description: Free-text comment, e.g. why the entry is locked or muted. Kept by the generator. Required when gate is set.

gate.description: Mute this key until the date in 'until': violations are reported as warnings and never block (09-REQ-26), also above the hard limit. Requires note and until (D-25).

until.description: Last day (UTC, inclusive) of muting. From the next day the key blocks again (09-REQ-26).
